note: Section override for build_timeline.py. Each section starts on the downbeat of `bar` (bar 0 = song start). Boundaries drafted from allin1 + lyrics + energy, verified against demucs stems with tools/verify_beats.py (2026-10-15). `hits` = accent points inside a section (e.g. the drop) for P5 cuts and P9 beat effects.

sections.label: hook
sections.basis: energy 3->8 at bar 5; lyric 3 '321 LIVE AI'

sections.label: prechorus
sections.basis: bar 16 is a drum fill into bar 17; 8-bar verse; lyric 8 pickup at 38.44s (rejected alt: bar 16)

sections.label: chorus1
sections.basis: lyric 12 'LIVE AI' at 48.38s after the bar-20 fill; bar 21 is a stripped bar (no kick/bass) (rejected alt: bar 22, see hits)

sections.label: build
sections.basis: drums and bass halve at bar 37; lyric 21 at 85.34s; bar 38 is a 3-beat stop-time bar (rejected alt: bar 38)

sections.label: outro
sections.basis: bass drops at bar 57; lyric 32 at 129.82s; bar 58 is silence + final stinger (rejected alt: bar 58)

hits.basis: kick, bass and pad all enter together after the stripped bar 21; highest novelty (1.84)
